articles.title: Talks to sell PayPal to Stripe and Advent are heating up
articles.summary: PayPal is still reportedly negotiating a potential sale to Stripe and private equity firm Advent, as the fintech firm's new CEO attempts to turn the company around.

articles.title: Donald Trump to declare Hormuz US territory 'soon'
articles.summary: Donald Trump said the strait would become part of the US after Iran is defeated. He also told Americans to accept higher gas prices, which have soared since Iran closed Hormuz in response to US and Israeli attacks.
